clue.text: Noel is upset by the injury

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disordered, so the letters of the two words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone called Noel is distressed by an injury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' looks like the verb of the sentence but is part of the fodder: NOEL + IS rearranged by 'upset'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lesion is a wound or damaged patch of tissue, a kind of harm to the body.

clue.text: Artist to go after six with an ill, tempered woman

indicators.note: after says the artist and the going come behind the number six in the answer

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
RA stands for Royal Academician, an artist
taken as written

explanation.surface: An artist is told to leave after six o'clock along with a bad-tempered woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The comma splitting 'ill, tempered' is a newspaper rendering of 'ill-tempered'.
explanation.definitionFit: A virago is a domineering, scolding female, a shrew.

clue.text: Unfounded strongholds?

parts.note: fortresses with no foundations would float above the ground, an image for baseless daydreams

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means fanciful plans with no basis in reality, as a fortress without footings would be.

clue.text: Hide group on the point including some soldiers

indicators.note: including says the soldiers sit inside the word for a group

parts.note: a sect is a religious faction or group
RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of British soldiers
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Instructions to conceal a band of people at a headland, with troops among them.
explanation.definitionFit: To secrete something is to conceal it away, a less common sense beside the glandular one.

clue.text: Not a straightforward stream of electricity

definitions.text: Not a straightforward stream of electricity

parts.words: Not a straightforward stream of electricity
parts.note: electric flow that is roundabout rather than direct, playing on the AC/DC terms

explanation.definitionFit: A play on direct current: a flow of electricity that is not direct would be its oblique opposite.

clue.text: Communist to prohibit stranger going round, we hear

indicators.note: going round says the stranger encircles the word meaning prohibit
we hear says the stranger's word is taken by its sound, not its usual spelling

parts.note: an alien is a foreigner or stranger
to ban is to prohibit

explanation.surface: A party member decides to outlaw a foreigner who is touring, according to rumour.
explanation.walkthrough: Albania was a Communist state under Enver Hoxha, so a native of it was a Communist in the period of the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Albania was a Communist state for decades after the war, so its citizen served as an example of one.

clue.text: One or two boys associated with David

definitions.text: One or two boys associated with David

parts.note: Jo is a boy's name
Nathan is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A youngster, or perhaps a pair of them, linked with someone called David.
explanation.walkthrough: One boy's name splits into two shorter names. In the Bible, Jonathan was David's devoted friend, son of King Saul.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Old Testament, Saul's son was the closest friend of David, famously loving him as his own soul.

clue.text: One with a single-minded approach to life

definitions.text: One with a single-minded approach to life

parts.words: One with a single-minded approach to life
parts.note: single-minded is read as minded to stay single, i.e. unmarried

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who abstains from marriage and sex is determined to remain single.

clue.text: Seaman in hold

definitions.meaning: Admiral Lord ..., Britain's most famous naval commander
a wrestling hold with the arm under the opponent's armpit

explanation.definitionFit: The admiral of Trafalgar was a sailor, and a wrestling grip shares his surname.

clue.text: Way of paying for fish

definitions.meaning: cash on delivery, settling up when goods arrive
a common North Atlantic food fish

explanation.definitionFit: Cash on delivery is a payment method, and the same three letters name a white-fleshed food fish.

clue.text: The girl's bloomer is a calamity

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, so the girl's is DI'S
an aster is a flower, something that blooms

explanation.surface: A young woman's blunder is described as a catastrophe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a mistake but here means a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean a sudden great misfortune or catastrophe.

clue.text: One sinful one in Nigeria

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
bad means wicked or sinful
an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.walkthrough: Ibadan is a large city in south-west Nigeria; the definition is a place found in that country.
explanation.definitionFit: This large city lies in the south-west of the country, so it is a place located there.

clue.text: Rowing coach having had too many?

definitions.meaning: the cox sits facing the eight oarsmen, a single person beyond the crew
slightly drunk, having drunk more than the limit

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means tipsy; literally it describes the coxswain, a ninth person in charge of an eight-oar crew.

clue.text: Part of the weekend supplement

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a portion of the letters of the following word

explanation.surface: A section of the Saturday newspaper's magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: To eke out is to supplement scant resources by adding to them.

clue.text: Pies cat upset are not likely to go bad

indicators.note: upset means overturned and jumbled, so the letters of pies and cat are rearranged

explanation.surface: Pies knocked over by a cat will not spoil.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sterile is free of the bacteria that cause decay, so it will keep.

clue.text: Press men in Chinese port

definitions.meaning: to press-gang sailors, forcing them into service at sea
the great city on the Yangtze delta

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to kidnap men for a ship's crew, and it is also the name of a major Chinese seaport.

clue.text: Was successful, we hear, in the examination of the country

indicators.note: we hear says the words for was successful are taken by sound

parts.note: passed, as in passing a test
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: Someone did well in the test of rural studies, by all accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes rural life and the countryside.

clue.text: Making amends in Tonga revolution

indicators.note: a revolution turns things over, so the letters of the two words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A political uprising in a Pacific kingdom as a form of reparation.
explanation.walkthrough: Tonga is a Pacific island kingdom; 'revolution' suggests politics but signals the anagram of IN TONGA.
explanation.definitionFit: To atone is to make up for a wrong, so the present participle means making reparation.

clue.text: One engineer to finish the cake?

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
CE stands for civil engineer

explanation.surface: Is one engineer supposed to complete the baking?
explanation.definitionFit: Icing is the final decorative coating applied to a cake.

clue.text: According to the panel, this crime was committed

definitions.text: According to the panel, this crime was committed

parts.note: per means according to, as in per the rules
a jury is a panel of citizens judging a case

explanation.surface: The jury's verdict is that this offence took place.
explanation.walkthrough: Fittingly, lying under oath is a crime a jury would rule on.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying under oath is an offence that a jury may find committed.

clue.text: Put the matter for discussion on a more elevated plane

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to bring up a topic, and literally it means lifting that topic higher.

clue.text: Odd collection of Biblical characters

parts.note: Job is the patient sufferer of the Old Testament
Lot is Abraham's nephew who fled Sodom

explanation.surface: A motley assortment of figures from scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: An auction term for a mixed bundle of assorted items sold together.

clue.text: An infant rock-and-roller

parts.note: not a young musician but the baby's bed that rocks and rolls

explanation.definitionFit: A baby's rocking bed sways back and forth, so it rocks an infant.

clue.text: Pass over troubled region

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed, so the letters of region are rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: To disregard or take no notice of something is to pass it by.

clue.text: A very large bottle for an old king

definitions.meaning: a wine bottle holding several standard bottles
the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel

explanation.definitionFit: Large wine bottles are named after this king of Israel in the Old Testament.

clue.text: During Friday used a Japanese fish

indicators.note: during says the answer runs through the middle of the following words

explanation.surface: Someone served sweetfish from Japan at the end of the week.
explanation.walkthrough: The ayu, or sweetfish, is a small freshwater fish prized in Japan.
explanation.definitionFit: The sweetfish of Japanese rivers, prized for its flavour.

clue.text: One's returning, going round at a distance in the hunt

indicators.note: going round says the reversed letters enclose the phrase for at a distance
returning says the letters for one's are read backwards

parts.note: I is one, so one's is I'S, written IS
afar means far away

explanation.surface: Someone comes back, circling from far off in the chase.
explanation.definitionFit: An expedition to hunt big game in Africa.

clue.text: Only dram that had been spilt accidentally

indicators.note: spilt suggests scattered, so the letters of only and dram are mixed up

explanation.surface: The only drink to have been knocked over was spilled by chance.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean by chance, without plan or pattern.
